Effekseer for WebGL runtime and sample effects from the official
EffekseerForWebGL 1.80.3 release:
https://github.com/effekseer/Effekseer/releases/download/1803/EffekseerForWebGL1.80.3.zip

The runtime and bundled sample resources are distributed under the MIT license
in LICENSE. Only the WebGL runtime and effects used by the battle renderer are
included here.

Character effect sources:

- Butterflies and celebration: HATO-Springhascome from the
  [official Effekseer sample effects](https://effekseer.github.io/en/contributes/HATO01/index.html)
  collection (CC0).
- Fireworks, aura, barrier, and vortex: the
  [Effekseer ResourceData](https://github.com/effekseer/ResourceData/tree/master/samples)
  sample collection. Only files directly referenced by these effects are included.
  The normal texture is stored as an 8-bit PNG to keep the download small.
